parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the business space. If you do not specify this parameter, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: KnowledgeType
parameters.description:
The knowledge type. Valid values:
- 1: common knowledge
- 3: document knowledge.

parameters.name: ParentCategoryId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent category. Default value: -1, which indicates the root directory.

parameters.name: ShowChildrens
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include child nodes. Valid values:
- false: No.
- true: Yes.
